name: com.cardatasales/spain-dgt
title: CarDataSales — Spain DGT & Europe Car Registrations
description: Daily Spain DGT car registrations, regional EV share, license plates & EU EV benchmarks.

tools.name: get_spain_registrations_summary
tools.description: Get an official Spain DGT passenger-car (M1) registrations executive summary for a given month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY), optionally filtered by Spanish Autonomous Community (CCAA). Returns total registrations, fuel/powertrain mix (BEV, PHEV, HEV, Petrol, Diesel, Gas), Top 5 brands, Top 5 models, Top 5 pure electric (BEV) models, and sales channel split (Particulares, Empresas, Alquiler).

period.description: Use 'month' for a single month (default: latest available DGT month) or 'year' for YTD / full year.

month.description: Optional target month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2026-11'). Defaults to latest available DGT month when period='month'.

year.description: Optional target year in YYYY format (e.g. '2026', '2025', '2024'). Defaults to current latest DGT year.

ccaa.description: Optional Spanish Autonomous Community (e.g. 'Cataluña', 'Madrid', 'Navarra', 'Galicia', 'Andalucía'). Leave empty for all of Spain.

tools.name: get_spain_ccaa_electrification_ranking
tools.description: Rank all 17 Spanish Autonomous Communities (plus Ceuta & Melilla) by 100% electric (BEV) and Zero-Emission (BEV+PHEV) market share, showing each region's current #1 propulsion technology and percentage-point gap for BEV to become the #1 technology.

period.description: Analyze either a single month ('month') or full year / YTD ('year').

month.description: Optional YYYY-MM month when period='month' (defaults to latest available DGT month).

year.description: Optional YYYY year when period='year' (defaults to latest available DGT year).

tools.name: get_spain_brand_summary
tools.description: Get annual Spain DGT registrations summary for a specific automotive brand (e.g. 'TOYOTA', 'TESLA', 'BYD', 'LEAPMOTOR', 'DACIA', 'VOLKSWAGEN'), with optional head-to-head comparison against a second brand and optional CCAA filter. Returns YTD units, market share, fuel mix, Top 5 models, and multi-year trend (2023–2026).

compare_brand.description: Optional second brand name for side-by-side comparison.

tools.name: get_spain_latest_dgt_plate
tools.description: Get the latest official Spanish vehicle license plate series and number issued by the DGT (e.g. '7160 NVJ'), date of issue, next upcoming 3-letter series, and recent series timeline.

tools.name: get_europe_ev_comparison
tools.description: Compare passenger-car registrations and electric vehicle (BEV & PHEV) market share across Spain (DGT), Germany (KBA), France (PFA), and the United Kingdom (SMMT) for a given year.
